title: Karbobala Noore doainam Kuja aast
body:
Karbobala Noor E Do Aainam Kuja Aast
Syed E Mazloom Hussainam Kuja Aast
1. Tootiye Khush Naghma E Bagh E Jinah
Kooh Ali Asgher E Sheeren Zabaan
Raft Ba Maidaan Paaye Aab E Rawaan
Neesth Nawaish Ze Che Dar Nainawah
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kooh Haram E Mohtaram E Buturab
Zainab E Aafsurda E Bi Sabr O Taab
Baqht Sakina Ze Che Rafta Ba Khwab
Shud Bakafe Shumr E Layeen Mubtelaa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aaoun Che Shud Jaffer E Bi Yaar Kooh
Qasim E Bi Monis E Gham Khwar Kooh
Hazrat E Abbas Alamdar Kooh
